notes.title: Happy New Year
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

On discord, Umbrae Stragis shared some interesting ideas with us: what will the characters of Chaos Galaxy do in the new year? The following content comes from him.

[i]I bet Duke Gaoshan has some sort of ceremonial parade where he rides around on a palanquin. He probably also displays the princess in her own palanquin so that no one can question his legitimacy. 
Eastgalaxy corp probably has a mercantile holiday? And Kleven maybe throws a party with all the executive members of his corporation?

Pretty sure Li Chengsong's faction goes to visit the graves of their loved ones. The girl (whose name I can't recall) goes to visit the grave of her dead fiance, and Li Chengsong visits his father's grave.

Lycurgus and Hera probably hold some kind of olympian sporting event to celebrate the coming of the new year, and the winners are granted the chance to pilot elite mechs like Ares.

I can totally see them seated in the royal wing of a Colosseum looking on as gladiator mechs fight to the death. 

That angry looking guy from Southheaven fleet probably goes around checking how the preparations for his revolution are coming along and making connections with people he'll need in the coming war, like networking. Chen Hentai... I mean Wentai, probably works overtime to assess troop morale and tries to throw together entertainment for the new year to distract the galactic empire.

Bontenmaru, now I'm not sure how everyone else sees her character, but in my opinion, probably lets all her troops celebrate and do their own thing while she retires to a secret mountain lair or something to meditate next to a candle in a dark room while holding a Katana, trying to gain a better understanding for the way of the sword and by extension life.

The leader of the Kurushima pirates strikes me as the sort of guy who is loved by his people, so they probably have a celebration where he is sorta like the chief guest? And they all make plans for the future and do wholesome stuff for the betterment of their community, while also plotting ambushes against the galactic empire.

Black Khalif Jihad... they probably have some kind of mandatory sermon by the Khalif that everyone has to attend? And they renew their faith in the religion that he preaches and maybe make sacrifices and whatnot, who knows, BKJ is a bit of  mystery to me. 

The Omnic Apocalypse will probably lauch a major invasion knowing full well that most human factions would be engaged in celebration or festivities and would not be expecting the spanish inquisition... I mean Omnic assault. But then they would be thwarted by the Mozi Order cause they built the AI and they know how they think and are always cautions.

Your friendly neighborhood assassins would of course be engaged in the shadow war, taking pot shots at high profile targets and using the revelry to help them blend in and disappear.[/i]

Umbrae stragis is really an imaginative guy, isn't he? I think Duke Gaoshan may deliver a new year's speech on galaxy TV, but unfortunately no one watches. Maybe he'll text everyone's phones. Do you have any interesting ideas?

Finally, Let's see the New Year wishes from Princess Jing. What' more, Chaos Galaxy 2 will launch the Early Access in June. Don't forget to add it to the wish list in advance. Thank you!

notes.title: Chaos Galaxy Complete Version
notes.content:
Hello, friends.

Chaos Galaxy has been updated for more than three months since it was released on June 16. We have made 82 game optimizations and modified 73 bugs. Added 20 special flagships, Space Lanes system, and Badge, Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds, Emoticons. So far, thIS game has basically achieved my goal of the Complete Version.

However, Chaos Galaxy still has many shortcomings, for example, the workshop and alien factions, which have been suggested many times by players, have not added to the game. Due to my lack of experience, the code of Chaos galaxy is not suitable for Mod function; as for the alien, I feel my previous attempts in Chaos Sector are not entirely satisfactory. I want to create more interesting alien monsters and behaviors, as well as a series of new units derived from a new technology trees players can get from fighting against aliens, etc., but these contents will certainly destroy the existing game structure of Chaos Galaxy. In addition, I think the planetary management system in Chaos Galaxy is too simple, and I hope to completely redo a planetary building system.

All these regrets will be made up in my next game. Yes, Chaos Galaxy will have a sequel. The next game is not just a systematic upgrade of Chaos Galaxy, but a real sequel to the story's timeline. Many factions in Chaos Galaxy will perish, some will split, some will be wandering, and new factions will appear on the stage of the Galaxy. You can think of the relationship between Chaos Galaxy and the next sequel as the relationship between Star Wars 1 and Star Wars 2 or Warhammer 40000 7th and 8th Edition. The story will move forward and the game system will be changed in some ways while inheriting the merit of the old. I want to spend ten years to make Chaos Galaxy into a series of games with an in-depth story background.

I expect to release some details of the sequel early next year. I hope you can keep an eye on the Chaos Galaxy universe!

If you find some bugs of Chaos Galaxy or have some suggestions for the sequel, please post it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. I will continue to modify the newly discovered bugs in Chaos Galaxy, and I will use your suggestions as a reference for the design of the sequel. Thanks very much for your help and support!

notes.title: Version 1.13 update
notes.content:
Gameplay improvement:

1. Beginner mode is available. Choosing beginner mode at the start of a campaign will increase the player base-income of gold and supply.
2. After being bombarded by a map weapon, the units in stealth will appear.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed some bugs about the commander's tactical bar on the battlefield.
2. Fixed some bugs that enemy units' level-icon and energy bar animation sometimes can be seen through the battlefield fog.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.12 update
notes.content:
Gameplay improvement:

1. We slightly increase the diplomatic requirements of Ask for war and slightly reduce the diplomatic requirements of Hire for war.
2. Planets with features of Wasteland will no longer be a mission target of the yearly strategic meeting.
3. When AI selects a war target, it will only select from factions with planet lanes connected to its own planets.
4. Only some specific factions' commanders will get the skills Invisible and Inkognito when they are promoted.
5. Seiged planets will be cut off from their lanes to the other planets.
6. AI stealth units on the battlefield will try to stay away from enemy units.
7. A sleeping fleet's button will display the word Sleeping, and the button will have no animation.
8. Some text has been adjusted.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a bug that when AI ambushing players, if we don't watch the animation, the damage calculation result will be based on a normal attack.
2. Fixed a bug that the relationship with allies doesn't increase when we assisting allies in auto battle.


If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.11 update and Space Lane system available
notes.content:
New content:

1. A new Space lane system is available. The planets are connected by lanes now. Our fleet can move by twice range on the lanes between our planets and the friendly planets.
2. New commander's random skills added: Tactical Genius, Telepathy, Invisible, Inkognito. The commanders with higher Military are more likely to have random skills of military-type on Promotion, and commanders with higher Administer are more likely to have random skills of admin-type on Promotion.
3. The Transfer ability of troops has been remade. Now a transfer unit can reach the destination directly without encountering ambush on the road and can cross the asteroid belt area. If the transfer unit is ambushed by a submarine at the destination, it will jump back to the starting point after the fight.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/cff3dec57928a6bd24007f6c603b2b97d2ebc29f.png[/img]

Gameplay improvement:

1. The Mozi order's policy Precise Fortgun was replaced by Fort Armour, Fortgun Range was replaced by Fort En-recycle. the effects of those policies were also adjusted. The faction difficulty of the Mozi order was changed to normal.
2. The fleet composition of AI has been adjusted. Now most AI fleets will not have two support units.
3. When the game window loses focus, the game sound will no longer be played.
4. Fixed some damage calculation ways for auto battles.
5. Increased more Agility when unit level up. High-level mecha units become easier to dodge enemy fire now.
6. Red Samurai's movement increased by 1.
7. When attacked by the second attack of Double Shooting or Double Chopping, the attacked unit can only do dodge now.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a bug that units did not gain experience in auto-battle.
2. Fixed a bug about occasionally miss on the 100% hit rate.
3. Fixed bugs about game stuck in several diplomacy and events.
4. Fixed some bugs when selecting fleets in the strategy scene.
5. Fixed a bug about the tactics skill Dimension Disorder.
6. Fixed a bug in the combat animation of the Red Samurai.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

3. On the diplomatic UI, now we can see how many planets the selected faction has.

5. The models of the flagships of the Omnic Apocalypse have been adjusted.
6、The moving speed of units on the battlefield is faster now.
7.  In the faction selection UI, the difficulty of the Lycurgus Corps is adjusted from hard to normal, and the difficulty of the Aerie Assassins is adjusted from hell to hard,
8. The Omnic Apocalypse's policy Wide Command was changed to a new policy Component, and the effect was also modified.
9. Improved AI's priority in using the Devour ability of space worms.

Fix bugs:

1. Fixed a bug about a hit rate of 0% that could still hit.
2. Fixed a bug about the Overhaul ability failed to repair friendly units.
3. Fixed a bug that title skill Invincible didn't work correctly.
4. Fixed a bug that the damage details on the fight UI sometimes is incomplete.
5. Fixed a bug that the map weapons did not gain damage modify correction.
6. Fixed a bug that the Westwaste Fleet's policy Starkiller Range failed to increase the range of Starkiller.
7. Fixed a bug in the battle animation of Fogblade.
8. Fixed a bug in the combat animation of the Suicide Nuke Servitor.
9. Fixed a bug that space hackers may use virus ability on targets already infected.
10. Fixed a bug that some tactical skills might allow the fortress to gain movement ability.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

Advance notice for next update:
A big update will be available at the end of this month about the Space Lanes system, and some modify about the random skills of commanders. Coming soon!

notes.content:

1. Twenty powerful new flagship units join the game, each belongs to the leader of each faction and several important commanders. We can get their collections by defeating them on the battlefield.
2. New planetary features added to the game: Science center, Logistics center, Media capital, Fortress planet. and most other planetary features have been modified. This content needs a new game to take effect.
3. The number of save slots has increased from 6 to 18.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/3b101007a27faccf2d601c4fc189ececd6d9fe2a.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay improvement:[/b]

1. The gold cost for early policies of all factions has been reduced.
2. The lead, power, and price of the Spaceworm were reduced, and the policy tree order about the Spaceworm was adjusted.
3. The damage of Map weapons no longer change randomly.
4. The conditions for the event Punish Southsea, Punish Eastgalaxy, 2nd AI War, Death of Princess, and Princess Crowned have been adjusted. When the related factions are vassals of other factions, no event will occur.
5. After a successful temptation, we can now control the target unit for 3 turns instead of 1 turn.
6. At the start of a turn, all units will detect the submarines around them as at the end of a turn.
7. The camera will be moved to the selected fleet when you choose a reinforcement fleet before a battle.
8. Duplicate buff names will no longer appear in the fight animations.
9. When an AI unit has Double Shooting effect, AI will give priority to using ammunition weapons to attack the enemy.
10. AI will no longer supply a unit with Supply ability.
11. Modified the sound effect of God Fist.

[b]Fix bugs:[/b]

1. Fixed a bug about Southeaven Fleet's policy Valiant.
2. Fixed a bug about the tactical skill Sand Assault.
3. Fixed a bug about the diplomatic command Offer planet.

If you find any bug after the update, please report it on the Steamcommunity or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Chaos Galaxy Developer Story
notes.content:
Hello everyone. I'm Han Zhiyu, the indie developer of Chaos Galaxy.

Since I was a child, I have been addicted to such Strategic games as Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Super Robot Wars, Advanced Wars, etc. I dreamed of making games like this one day. so in 2007, I joined a big game company.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/11cd6769cbcef5bca1d88c61bd53266b71fbfda8.png[/img]

I have made MMORPGs and mobile games for ten years. But I found myself making F2P games all the while. I can't feel the fun of playing games of my childhood.

Finally, I couldn't stand it anymore three years ago. I resigned from my job to pursue my childhood dream. I began to make my favorite strategy game by myself.

After more than one year's development, an experimental work called Chaos Sector was published on Steam. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/4b952a6b59e066c9e58cd38dcf8fdbfe92b8da23.png[/img]

The game has many design flaws, but thanks to the friends who bought Chaos Sector and helped me, I got confidence and encouragement.

After another year and a half, Chaos Galaxy, the first major work of the Chaos universe is finally complete.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/d45ff2ad78a9a1f9f89ccdc514b4eef7a9de1893.png[/img]

In Chaos Galaxy, you can choose one of 14 factions. There are dozens of heroes with different skills and hundreds of mecha and starships with different characteristics. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/aab5872d172e86ae24fcbf6751909d56fbcc3151.png[/img]

You can develop planets, research technology, conduct diplomacy, and launch battles in the Galaxy. All factions and heroes have their own stories, and you will meet new events and new situations in each game.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/85b1caac25776b53b86cff3a2886d295bfaecc45.png[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/f2d108af234b12304ba206a26a5dd0064b5f4365.png[/img]

In the free demo of Chaos Galaxy, you can play an Imperial fleet to destroy the pirates within a limit of three years. Even a skilled strategic gamer may need to try several times before they can complete this task. Good luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/d492586f887761878e6dc34082dae04486b42fdd.png[/img]

Also, I am the translator of the Chinese publisher for Warhammer 40000. I have translated two Warhammer 40000 books to Chinese: the Dark Imperium and the Visions of Heresy.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/453c7e3d97d3bf54e6ee0ecc1f3be4a1603f4422.png[/img]

I also want to pass the Chinese style space fantasy story to the world through my game. I hope you will enjoy it! Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/4891b030d488cf915eb98c50a3233cc66b128e6a.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Diary of March
notes.content:
Long time no see, dear friends!

In March, I have made great progress in the development of Chaos Galaxy.

Excluding a series of historical events and diplomatic AI that I have mentioned before, I have added the following game contents:

1. You can now have your commanders fight automatically and report the results to you.

2. Reinforcements can now be selected from all fleets within a radius of 4 squares around the battlefield point. The distant fleet will arrive a few turns later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/5384949caef46354974705b634199afdc67f5f99.png[/img]

3. Your fleets can exchange their units now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/2b83ae85a70a17f564628744d6ab127090953d15.png[/img]

4. When you select a faction, you can see the faction type and the difficulty class

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/94e570dcffbdc62b8a4785e11b3db3fba2001a24.png[/img]

5. Now it is possible to appoint the Counsellor (the administrative spokesman at the meeting) and the Marshal(the military spokesman at the meeting). You can also fire your commanders now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/f43ce788818c1e6e0d18ec755fb0e1855e854cb6.png[/img]

6. I modified the command panel of the fleet to make the interface more eye-catching. The operation has also been modified.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/b3d0f61ec98edbe9f5df64d79f21a004076ab996.png[/img]

7. In the end, there is a huge system: Collection. It includes 61 heroes, 99 units and 48 events to be collected in many different ways. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/3703ca975fff0c1b15e29b2e3db912d392ad4177.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/827c02eed14aa9f1e8820380dffb2b47deef47d9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/1784fa633efabce6030618a3d159ece2d8fecde1.png[/img]

The time for the publishing is coming in a few months!

notes.title: Dev Diary of February
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This month, the development content of chaos galaxy is mainly about faction random events. Here are some screenshots of the assassination event, merchant trade, enemy new weapon, and other events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/e21f2bf762d75238e256c371b45ee786710c3abd.png[/img]
As you act the Assassin faction or have subordinates of assassins and ninjas, you will trigger the assassination event
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/bd7a493ca7ab6ac379fcde133e0ce12d4595c2fe.png[/img]
You need to choose how to invade to enemy flagship
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/a867094a978981508705b57b6f02eaf0d4befeb0.png[/img]
And the means of assassination
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/c0624bd71164a9c60eb56e5e46af69491b7e9837.png[/img]
Businessmen factions can make a variety of trade and investment
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/28d99d6012400e6b68d42e48da099dc766349fec.png[/img]
Omnic faction can get new blueprint by analyzing the remains of new enemy weapons

Now each faction will have a series of random events in line with the background of the story. The oppression from the imperial court, the plunder of the pirates, the invitation for mercenaries and so on will have their own performance.

Next, I will make a series of historical events. For example, a large-scale civil war involving all the roles of the Empire, subordinate countries and allies. You can choose to build your own dynasty or to revive the Galactic Empire with the princess. Lead Omnic robots to destroy all human beings, and even build a huge communication tower to summon the alien hordes from outside the Galaxy!

Chaos galaxy is in the final months of its sprint, and I hope it will be released in June. Coming soon!

notes.title: Dev Diary of Jan
notes.content:
Let's introduce the recent progress of the Chaos Galaxy. The main goal of this month is painting.
First of all, the number of commanders has increased from 54 to 61 (Now players will not lack commanders).

All the characters now have a little model for the performance of meetings and events. In addition, according to the different cultures of various factions, seven kinds of meeting room scenes are drawn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/9c486797d186920c2bd633cbe818bd7aea7cbb09.gif[/img]
The Merchant factions, the decoration style is very expensive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/59c501d678bdf477f18dc16f91cada55f70f99a0.gif[/img]
The Pirate factions, on the contrary, are very poor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/97636375fae2a64c6eed7871f5d0fed9a58cabb6.gif[/img]
The Mercenary factions are always discussing tactics operations. If oral discussions are not possible, discuss it with a knife.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/d314f7bc826280fdafc807965ac23bdb2d90b853.gif[/img]
The Imperial fleets, we've all seen it in the demo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36212768/991d3aa2e8b6c6ff9cb2e7360bca2e7ae3a163ed.gif[/img]
The Sandsea factions, the old federal style.

Next month, I will launch the development of the event system. For example, there will be looting events for pirates, investment events for merchants, mercenaries attack other factions for money, and assassins to kill somebody events, etc. And there will also be a huge chain of events about the great civil war of the Empire.

Happy Happy lunar new year. See you next month!
